This section organizes my course syllabi, lecture notes, R code files, and interactive Bookdown books. These materials are designed to accompany my courses and help students develop practical computing and statistical inference skills.

## Courses

### 📊 Statistical Computing and Non-Parametric Inference using R

**Institution:** Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE)

A comprehensive postgraduate course designed to teach the fundamentals of statistical computing, data management, and non-parametric statistical methods using R.

**Topics covered:**
* R Programming Fundamentals, vector calculations, coercion, and mathematical transformations.
* Descriptive Statistics: central tendency, dispersion, skewness, and kurtosis.
* Confidence Intervals for means and proportions.
* Contingency Tables and Chi-Square tests.
* Non-Parametric Inference: Sign test, Wilcoxon Signed-Rank test, and Mann-Whitney U test.
